sum: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or a material event triggering mandatory takeover code compliance.
detail: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
